title: Ms. Tree's Thrilling Detective Adventures #3 Eclipse 1983 Frank Miller Pin-Up
conditionDescription: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Ms. Tree's Thrilling Detective Adventures #3 (1983), Eclipse Comics. By Max Allan Collins and Terry Beatty. Includes a Famous Detective pin-up by Frank Miller, plus The Scythe. $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: Eclipse Monthly ad (Marshall Rogers).

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
